issues.description: Default base image is duplicated in three places without a single source of truth
issues.detail: The literal 'python:3.12' appears in backend pipeline.py (DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE), the Jinja template's or-chain fallback was replaced but the TS side hardcodes it twice (Commands.ts fallback, CellMetadataEditor.ts DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE export). When the Python default changes, three call sites drift. State the invariant: the backend is authoritative; the TS fallback is only for RPC failure and should be labeled as such.

issues.description: Semantic change: empty base_image no longer falls through to kfp default
issues.detail: Previously self.base_image = '' allowed the Jinja template's 'or' chain to leave selection to kfp/component defaults. Now it is forced to 'python:3.12' inside _set_base_image, which silently overrides any downstream defaulting and changes runtime behavior for users who relied on the empty sentinel. The comment above the line still says 'Use kfp default image' but the code no longer does that. Update the comment or preserve the sentinel.

issues.description: Reset-to-default button cannot distinguish 'unset' from 'explicitly default'
issues.detail: updateBaseImage('') is used both to clear and to represent 'use default'. Combined with the pipeline.py change that maps '' to DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE, the user can no longer express 'inherit from pipeline base_image' separately from 'use global default'. The invariant for which fallback wins (cell > pipeline > global default) is not stated and the data model has collapsed two states into one.

issues.description: Button width style:'5%' is meaningless inside a non-flex container
issues.detail: style={{ width: '5%' }} on a MUI Button wrapped in a div with marginRight:'4px' will not produce the intended sizing; the previous Input used width:'25%' of the flex row. Either move to flex sizing consistent with the row, or drop the width style. A reader cannot tell what layout is intended.

issues.description: RPC call on every panel load to fetch a compile-time constant
issues.detail: get_default_base_image returns a Python module-level constant. Round-tripping through RPC on every LeftPanel mount is unnecessary work and introduces a failure mode (the catch block) that the hardcoded TS fallback masks. Either bake the constant into the frontend at build time, or fetch it once and cache. Not a hot path, so the cost is small — but the architecture asks the reader to believe the value can change at runtime, which it cannot.

issues.description: Local import inside get_default_base_image with no stated reason
issues.detail: 'from kale.pipeline import DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE' is done inside the function body rather than at module top. There is no circular-import comment justifying it. Either move to the top of the file or add a one-line comment naming the cycle being avoided; otherwise the next reader will hoist it and discover the breakage at runtime.

review.summary: UNDER-AUDITED with NEEDS-LITERATE-COMMENT. The feature is small but the invariant "which base_image wins among cell, pipeline, global default" is never stated, and the default value 'python:3.12' is now duplicated across backend constant, TS constant, and TS fallback. The semantic change in pipeline._set_base_image (empty string is now coerced to the default) is the riskiest line in the diff and its accompanying comment is now wrong. The UI also collapses 'unset' and 'default' into one state, removing the user's ability to inherit-from-pipeline. Fixes are small: one source of truth, corrected comment, and an explicit fallback ladder documented in one place.
